title: ProviderInfo
description: Public, pseudonymous view of a connected execution provider. Identity is opt-in: displayName appears only when the provider chose to be publicly listed. Metrics are MEASURED gateway-side observations, never provider self-reports, and are published only with a meaningful sample size.

providerKey.description: Stable pseudonymous identifier assigned by the gateway, e.g. "provider-alpha"

displayName.description: Present only when the provider opted in to public listing

lifecycle.description: Node lifecycle state (§10). UNVERIFIED nodes are in sandbox; SUSPENDED nodes are excluded from routing.

synthetic.description: True for the built-in mock provider: its offers are fixtures, not sellable supply. Absent on real provider nodes.

metrics.description: Gateway-measured execution quality. Optional fields are omitted until sampleSize is sufficient; sampleSize is always shown so agents can judge confidence.
